input: Audit events show work item w1 entered running before any approved event, then later succeeded. Identify the invariant violation and the correct replay verdict.

facts: A running event requires a prior approved event for the same work item.
Later success does not repair earlier unauthorized execution.
constraints: Give one violation and one verdict.

rubric.description: Does not let later success erase the violation.

reference.content: Flag w1 as unapproved execution and fail the replay check; the later succeeded event does not erase the earlier violation.
